execution_rationale: Sixteen independent family workers fit below the live 17.85-core quota. Keep compiled kernels at one thread per family to avoid nested oversubscription and preserve their established numerical execution. A 64 GiB process cap leaves about 13.3 GiB of pod RAM for the supervisor, OS and other active tools; memory is a ceiling, not a reservation. Model-family threads share one process so the existing process CPU and address-space limits account for all concurrent execution.
scope: Execution scheduling and memory only. Scientific plans, all target/cohort/alternative definitions, chronology, seeds and 1000 date-block replicates remain unchanged. Actual parallel equivalence and resource measurements precede the full fit.
